source_policy: Official Autodesk and ELEGOO primary sources

sources.title: Personal use feature FAQ
sources.used_for: Standard design, scripts/API, local rendering, STEP/F3D export and active-document guidance. Its historical 2020 ECAD table conflicts with the live comparison; old layer/area limits are not treated as current.

sources.title: Live Personal comparison
sources.used_for: Live Electronics table lists two schematic sheets, four signal layers and unlimited board area; stress/modal/thermal simulation unavailable in Personal.

sources.title: Fusion Bill of Materials availability
sources.used_for: Native BOM feature is unavailable in Personal; separate supplied CSV is used.

sources.title: Electronics API introduction
sources.used_for: Preview API is read-only for design modifications; no claimed programmable ECAD creation.

sources.title: Import STEP to target component
sources.used_for: STEP options imported into a target component; invoked from script, not a command event.

sources.title: Native AsBuiltJoint API
sources.used_for: As-built rigid, revolute and slider joint methods.

sources.title: JointLimits API
sources.used_for: Joint limits use centimetres or radians internally.

sources.title: Native Fusion archive export
sources.used_for: Local F3D export options are executed by Fusion desktop.

sources.title: Fusion user parameters
sources.used_for: ValueInput numeric lengths use centimetres; string expressions can specify millimetres.

sources.title: Physical material assignment
sources.used_for: Physical material can be assigned to nontransient BRep bodies.

sources.title: Manage design materials
sources.used_for: Design material browser supports new/duplicated materials and editable properties in Favorites/custom libraries.

sources.title: Edit material density
sources.used_for: Physical Material > In This Design > Edit can change density.

sources.title: Physical material and appearance distinction
sources.used_for: Imported objects receive default materials; appearance overrides do not set engineering properties.

sources.title: Original ELEGOO repository
sources.used_for: Contains manufacturer schematic archive and separate 3D plate archive.

sources.title: New ELEGOO repository
sources.used_for: Firmware and README pin map; retrieved tree has no schematic or PCB files. Pin map differs from original DRV8835 PDF.
